scope: Parent-only support when school threats, bullying or repeated harm stops a kit. Not a move, practice script or research claim.

schoolHarm.title: Help with what happens next
lines: If your child is safe with you now, listen without blame. Let them know that being bullied is not their fault.
Contact the teacher, school counselor or principal. Ask what will keep your child safe when they return, and follow up with the school.
Threats of serious injury or serious physical harm need prompt police or medical help, even if your child is home now. If there is danger right now, call 911.
